description: Cut a grid-span layout into its tile posts, one for each of 3, 6 or 9 pictures, tied together as one set. post_id is a stills post made without accounts whose layout is a grid span (stills_change cut.set). The tiles post last tile first, a row of three at a time. The tiles are drafts with no times: call stills_set_schedule next, then a person approves them as any post. If the layout is already drawn the tiles have their pictures at once; otherwise they get them when the render finishes. The grid crop figure is unmeasured, so this stays off until the owner measures it with a test post on a real profile.

account_ids.description: Accounts from accounts_list that the tiles post to

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

post_id.description: The stills post whose layout is a grid span

spacing_minutes.description: Minutes between two tiles in posting order

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: stills_set_create
title: Make a grid span
